name: Polyglyph
desc: An AI localization platform for game studios. Pull strings straight out of Unreal, route each job to the model you choose, review every line with your team, then ship the approved translations back into the build.
bullets: Routes each translation job to the model and effort the studio picks, enforcing a per-project glossary and translation brief.
Review queue with human sign-off, stale-string detection when the source changes, and export to PO, XLIFF or JSON.
Unreal Engine plugin that pushes strings from the engine's own localization tools and pulls approved lines back.
Multi-tenant Fastify, Prisma and PostgreSQL backend with a background job queue, under a React 19 dashboard.
cv: Multi-provider LLM localization platform for game studios, built and operated solo: an Unreal plugin pushes strings, jobs route to Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral or xAI with batching and prompt caching to cut cost, and humans approve every line. Fastify, pg-boss, PostgreSQL and React on Render and Cloudflare Pages.

name: Synthform
desc: A synthwave roguelite action RPG. Everything in its world is a cube, and you are the one cube that can still become something else: pick a chassis, then evolve it room by room through drafted upgrades. Built on Three.js and WebGPU, with its own engine and editor.
bullets: Its own fixed-step engine on Three.js and WebGPU: a 60 Hz simulation, interpolated rendering, hitstop and a typed event bus.
A gameplay effect system modelled on Unreal's Gameplay Ability System, driving abilities and status effects.
An Unreal-style editor for levels, landscapes and Blueprint actors, saving diffable data to disk.
Five elemental biomes, and bosses that stay guarded until you punish an opening.
cv: Synthwave roguelite action RPG on its own Three.js and WebGPU engine, with a GAS-style effect system and an Unreal-style editor.
imageAlt: Synthform key art: a giant made of glowing cubes stands on a neon grid under a striped synthwave sun, ringed by the shapes a cube can become.

name: Counting Sheep
desc: A cozy pixel-art number puzzle roguelite with deckbuilding. Every sheep is a number: huddle them to add, play cards to multiply or raise them to a power, and count each nightmare off exactly. Count too many and the extras run off into the dark.
bullets: A rules engine in plain JavaScript, with a solver and a simulator that play full runs to tune the balance.
A Pixi.js client with spring-driven motion, shaders, and effects drawn as pixel sprites on the game's own grid.
Six pastures that each accept one kind of number: any, even, prime, square, Fibonacci, or a multiple of three.
A store page studio that draws the itch.io listing images from the game's own art.
cv: Number puzzle roguelite with deckbuilding: a JavaScript rules engine with a solver and simulator for balance, on Pixi.js.
imageAlt: Counting Sheep capsule art: a sleepy stone gargoyle leans on a moonlit fence among three pixel sheep, beside the Counting Sheep logo.

name: Unreal Engine Plugins
desc: Modular UE5 plugins covering combat, inventory, dialog, world streaming, and multiplayer social. Each one drops into a project without dragging a framework in behind it.

name: AI Infrastructure Consulting
desc: Governed AI infrastructure for game studios: a knowledge layer and a layered pipeline that make adoption safe, consistent, and measurable, on whichever AI stack the studio picks.

name: Sesqui
desc: A two-player connection game on an 8x8 board. Gold links top to bottom, pale links left to right. Play a friend, take on four tiers of AI, or watch the engines battle it out.
